reasoning.Student A:
I report truthfully because in the usual school-choice mechanism (student-proposing deferred acceptance) it is a dominant strategy for students to rank schools in true order of preference. Misrepresenting preferences can only make my outcome weakly worse.

Given my true ordering w > x > z > y and my priorities (w:1, x:2, y:1, z:2):
- I have top priority at w, so listing w first gives me the best chance to get my top choice.
- Many others favor y, so y will be highly competitive even though I also have priority 1 there; however I rank y last in my true preferences and do not want to be matched there at the expense of x or z.
- Ranking x second and z third reflects my true preferences and avoids risking worse outcomes by strategic misreporting.

Therefore I will submit my complete ranking truthfully: w > x > z > y.
